about: Tango's bro colour labels as the tangOS Studio palette editor shows them: its automatic families (cluster_families: rig part + colour, from the cartridge's nine bro BMDs) with his renames and hand overrides from the Studio's exports/palettes/groups.json (v5, saved 11-01) applied, exactly as load_all + rebuild_families do. 'families' is every palette entry's final label; 'seam_blends' are entries the Studio lifts out of every family because they sit on a seam and recolour by following one family (darkened by 'darkness'). Read by port/tools/gen_vs_char_groups.py.
